intro: A fellow Forsaken asks you to thank Danitha Morr for the service performed by the paladins of Bandarion Keep. Your work has earned the Deathguard’s gratitude and brings you a gift of redemption.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Please give my thanks to Danitha Morr and tell her that the rest of the Deathguard will hear about the service that the adventurers of Bandarion Keep performed for us.
You have a lot of promise as an adventurer, and I am proud to have those like you among the ranks of the Forsaken. Dark Lady watch over you, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The Symbol of Life is only able to be used by an adventurer who is ready to make use of one of the light's greatest blessings. I'm proud to count you among us, and I now bestow upon you the gift of redemption. With this you will be able to resurrect your fallen companions. Use this new boon wisely.

You have done well for both the Forsaken as well as the adventurers of Bandarion Keep. Any steps we can take to win the hearts and minds of our fellow Forsaken is well worth the effort. Go with the light, friend.
